info.name: Nextcloud Text & Hex Editor
info.summary: Edit text files and inspect binary files as hex inside Nextcloud
info.description:
# Nextcloud Text & Hex Editor
A lightweight Nextcloud editor for text-like files with read-only hex previews for binary files.
## Features
- Edit text-like files directly in Nextcloud - Preview binary files as hexadecimal rows with ASCII text - Read and edit Markdown documents directly in Nextcloud - Integrated file action for unknown and text-like file types - Switch between Text and Hex modes - Warn before discarding unsaved changes
## Notes
This app is intended for local Nextcloud file editing and hex inspection. Binary hex editing is not implemented.
